item.title: Webex AI Agent upgraded to GPT-5.4 with new Webex AI Pro 2.0 engines
item.description:
Webex AI Agent upgraded to GPT-5.4 with new Webex AI Pro 2.0 engines

Webex Contact Center announced a major upgrade for its AI Agent, moving the underlying model from GPT‑4.1 to GPT‑5.4.

🔍 Overview

The upgrade aims to provide more accurate, natural, and goal‑aligned conversations for end‑customers.

🆕 What’s New

  • Underlying model now GPT‑5.4 (previously GPT‑4.1).
  • Enhanced accuracy, more natural dialogue, and better prompt adherence.

⚙️ Engine Options

Engine Variant Region
Webex AI Pro 2.0 Global
Webex AI Pro US 2.0 United States
Webex AI Pro EU 2.0 Europe

🚀 How to Upgrade

  • Existing agents should be upgraded to version 2.0 to access the new capabilities.
  • Support for version 1.0 engines will end on February 15, 2027.

💡 Why it Matters

  • Greater accuracy helps resolve customer issues faster.
  • More natural conversations improve the overall user experience.
  • Improved prompt adherence keeps the AI aligned with specific business goals.

Upgrade now to leverage the latest AI performance in your contact‑center workflows.

#Webex #AI #GPT5 #ContactCenter

Source: What’s new for administrators in Webex Contact Center

item.title: ChatGPT Updates with GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 Models
item.description:
ChatGPT Updates with GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 Models

ChatGPT has updated its capabilities with the introduction of GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 models, expanding its utility as a general reasoning and generation assistant.

⚙️ Key details

  • Model Family: GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 provide substantially improved reasoning over earlier versions.
  • Deep Research Mode: Autonomously browses dozens of web sources to synthesise a structured report with citations.
  • Projects: Maintains persistent context and custom instructions across conversations to accumulate memory for ongoing research or writing projects.
  • Custom GPTs Marketplace: Offers pre-configured specialist assistants for specific tasks, industries, and knowledge domains.
  • Multi-modal Input: Handles text, images, files, PDFs, and voice.
  • Additional Integration: Includes web browsing for real-time information and DALL-E image generation within the interface.

🚀 Availability

  • Free Tier: Provides meaningful access to GPT-5.5 Instant.
  • Plus Tier: Costs $20 per month and unlocks the full model range, Advanced Voice, file analysis, and higher usage limits.

💡 Why it matters

By mid-2026, ChatGPT had adopted 500 million-plus weekly active users, becoming the most widely used AI assistant in the world. The Deep Research mode specifically moves the tool from answering individual questions to conducting multi-source research on behalf of the user.

#ChatGPT #GPT-5 #AI #GenerativeAI

Source: Tech Tuesday: The complete guide to AI chatbots and knowledge tools in 2026
